messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “Box Simulator Brawl Stars” game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Build immediately without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, at viewport width ≤1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires PNG.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone browser game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no external gameplay dependencies.
- Used original Brawl Stars-inspired crate, rarity, and brawler concepts with fictionalized simulator mechanics.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built box selection/opening, animated reward reveals, coins and gems, brawler collection, quests, drop-rate dialog, legendary-luck meter, keyboard shortcut, local save, and responsive mobile layouts.
- Checked JavaScript syntax with `node --check game.js`.
- Browser-tested page rendering, box opening, collection view, and mobile navigation; verified 8 roster cards and opened count updates.
- Captured and inspected `/tmp/opencode/box-brawl-check.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/box-brawl-reveal.jpg`.

### Active
- No active implementation step; final response remains to be provided.

### Blocked
- Browser console reports a missing `/favicon.ico` (404); otherwise no console errors were observed.

## Next Move
1. Optionally add a favicon or suppress the missing-favicon request.
2. Run any final checks and summarize the game and reasonable assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game structure and UI views.
- `styles.css`: Visual design, animations, and responsive layouts.
- `game.js`: Game logic, rewards, persistence, quests, and navigation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was launched with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser opened at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Playwright showed one 404 for `favicon.ico`; syntax and gameplay smoke checks passed.
